scorecard.coaching: Agent asked zero probing questions regarding the customer's actual data usage, devices, or speed requirements before offering a downgraded tier.

grader.scenario: Mid-contract price adjustment enquiry; agent is impatient and condescending and asks zero probing questions about household usage before offering contract tier
grader.notes: The agent reviewed contract terms and offered a discounted renewal tier to mitigate an inflationary price increase. However, the agent failed Build Rapport and Observed Professionalism at minute 4 when Tariq questioned the CPI plus 3.9% clause, snapping with condescension: 'If you had bothered to read section 8.4 of your contract agreement, you wouldn't need to ask me why prices rise every single April,' and failed Probing by asking zero diagnostic questions regarding Tariq's actual broadband usage, connected devices, or speed requirements before offering a package.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:18] Agent: 'I completely understand how concerning unexpected price rises are when you are managing a fixed monthly retirement budget, Tariq...' - Immediate and genuine empathy.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [08:45] Agent: 'Just to check on your current broadband service, Tariq, is your internet connection and WiFi performing normally across all rooms today?' - Harmless recheck of broadband service.
